{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure we start fresh
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for any non-numeric entries in the 'revenue' column
revenue_series = df['revenue']
print("Unique values in 'revenue':")
print(revenue_series.unique())

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any invalid conversions
invalid_count = df['revenue_numeric'].isna().sum()
print(f"Number of invalid revenue entries: {invalid_count}")"}
